attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 18 (6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 2,77,38,075 equity shares of APL Apollo Tubes Limited from S Gupta Holding Private Limited on November 23, 2026, through an on-market block deal on BSE Limited. The purchase price was INR 2,100 per share. This acquisition represents approximately 9.99% of the total equity shares of APL Apollo Tubes Limited. Tata Steel Limited had previously disclosed its intent as an acquirer in a public announcement issued on November 23, 2026. A detailed public statement is to be published no later than December 1, 2026. The acquired shares are placed in a share escrow account in terms of Regulation 22(2A) of the SEBI SAST Regulations. The shares will be released to Tata Steel Limited demat account upon the earlier of the expiry of twenty-one working days from the publication of the detailed public statement, provided consideration is deposited, or the expiry of the open offer period.

attchmntText: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 50000 securities pursuant to Non Convertible Securities at its meeting held on November 25, 2026
voiceSummary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has approved the allotment of 50,000 secured, redeemable, rated, listed, non-convertible debentures under PFL NCD Series H1 FY 2026-27 Re-Issuance I. The face value is Rs. 1,00,000 per debenture, totaling Rs. 500,00,00,000. Accrued interest is Rs. 1,62,94,500, premium is Rs. 8,07,160, and discount is Rs. 17,80,000. The Finance Committee authorized this allotment on November 25, 2026. The debentures carry a coupon rate of 9.1500% per annum. The original tenure is 1,826 days, with a residual tenure of 1,813 days. The date of maturity is Wednesday, November 12, 2031. The securities are secured by a first ranking pari passu charge on hypothecated properties. They will be listed in the Debt Market Segment of BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Bikaji Foods International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 25, 2026, titled "Bikaji Foods International Enters the Premium Bakery Segment with the Launch of Mahè under Bikaji Bakes".
voiceSummary: Bikaji Foods International Limited announced the launch of Mahè, a premium bakery brand under its subsidiary Bikaji Bakes Private Limited. The venture is in partnership with Master Baker T K Khaleel. The launch introduces European-inspired viennoiseries, artisan breads, and cakes to the Indian market. The brand will be unveiled at Bakery Biz Mumbai from 25 to 27 November 2026. Production is supported by a manufacturing facility in Karnataka. This move marks the company's entry into the commercial bakery and foodservice segment. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The press release was issued on 25 November 2026.

attchmntText: VTM Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding Memorandum of Understanding with Government of Tamil Nadu (GoTN)'.We wish to inform you that the Company has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Government of Tamil Nadu (GoTN) through its Nodal Agency "Guidance".
voiceSummary: VTM Limited has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Tamil Nadu through its Nodal Agency Guidance. Under this agreement, Guidance will provide infrastructural support and regulatory facilitation to help the Company obtain necessary permissions, approvals, clearances, and incentives from the relevant authorities in Tamil Nadu. This initiative reiterates the Company's commitment to invest in the State of Tamil Nadu. The Company has intimated this development to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India.

attchmntText: Kapston Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Postal Ballot. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Srutinizers report along with voting results.
voiceSummary: Kapston Services Limited announces that the resolution to alter its Capital Clause by subdividing equity shares from a face value of Rs.5 per share to Rs.1 per share has been passed with the requisite majority. The postal ballot via remote e-voting was conducted between October 25, 2026, and November 23, 2026. Scrutinizer D.S. Rao reports that out of 3,04,32,183 total shares, 2,28,78,837 votes were polled. All 2,28,78,737 valid votes were cast in favor, with zero votes against. The company has submitted the voting results and the scrutinizer’s report to the National Stock Exchange. The disclosure is available on the company website.

attchmntText: DPSC Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process-Newspaper advertisements pertaining to the 106th Annual General Meeting of the Company
voiceSummary: India Power Corporation Limited, formerly DPSC Limited, is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench-1, admitted the application under Section 7 of the IBC via an order dated 15th May, 2026. Consequently, the powers of the Board of Directors are suspended. The company has published newspaper advertisements in Financial Express and Aajkaal on 25th November, 2026, regarding its 106th Annual General Meeting. The meeting will be held through Video Conference or Other Audio Visual Means. The advertisements are also available on the company website at www.indiapower.com.

attchmntText: Rajratan Global Wire Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rajratan Global Wire Limited has approved the incorporation of a Wholly Owned Subsidiary in Europe. The Board of Directors approved this proposal during its meeting held on 25th November, 2026. The new entity will be named Rajratan Wire Europe or another name approved under European laws. The country of incorporation is the Netherlands. The listed company will hold 100% control of the subsidiary. The consideration for the shares will be in cash. Rajratan Global Wire Limited will subscribe to 100% of the initial paid-up share capital. The initial infusion amount is Euro 50,000. This amount will be provided in one or more tranches. No governmental or regulatory approvals are required for this incorporation. The subsidiary will not involve the acquisition of any existing entity.
